title: 5 easy, actionable tips for software development in healthcare
partialText: Big-picture thinking is great, but sometimes you just want tactics you can use today. Here are five quick tips from our recent healthcare security panel, covering everything from handling vendor outages to building your own AI-powered security scanner.

title: Announcing importmap-update: automated dependency updates for importmap-rails
partialText: Dependabot keeps your gems current, but it doesn't know about the JavaScript packages pinned in your Rails importmap. We're releasing a GitHub Action that opens pull requests for the ones that are outdated or vulnerable.
